```{r data loading and cleaning}
# Load participant files

data_files <- list.files(path = "harder", pattern = "^S.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
df <- rbindlist(lapply(data_files, fread), fill = TRUE) %>%
  select(participant, Story, Condition, text, corrAns, key_resp_4.keys, key_resp_4.corr) %>%
  mutate(SNR = "Minus10", key_resp_4.corr = as.numeric(key_resp_4.corr))

# Remove excluded participants
remove <- c("S211","S205","S130","S126","S011","S208",   # musicians
            "S188","S166","S100","S018",                 # hearing
            "S017","S025","S027","S043","S057","S058","S068","S078","S107","S122",
            "S143","S144","S147","S154","S155","S167","S170","S182","S192","S203",
            "S217","S220","S221","S223","S228","S233",   # no English
            "S138","S067","S110")                        # missing data
df <- df %>%
  filter(!participant %in% remove, !is.na(corrAns), corrAns != "")

```


```{r relabel conditions}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Condition = dplyr::recode(Condition,
    "Music"        = "Original",
    "Pitch"        = "Pitch scrambled",
    "Onset"        = "Rhythm jittered",
    "Pitch_Onset"  = "Pitch + Rhythm",
    "Reverse_Music"= "Reverse music",
    "Silent"       = "Silent"),
    Condition = factor(Condition,
       levels = c("Original","Pitch scrambled","Rhythm jittered","Pitch + Rhythm","Reverse music","Silent"))
  )
```

```{r main analyses: glmer models}
# Set reference levels
df$Condition <- relevel(df$Condition, ref = "Original")
df$participant <- factor(df$participant)
df$Story <- factor(df$Story)
df$text <- factor(df$text)

# Main model: Accuracy ~ Condition
hard_model <- glmer(
  key_resp_4.corr ~ Condition + (Condition | participant) + (Condition | Story/text),
  data = df, 
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2.5e5))
)

summary(hard_model)

# Export results
tab_model(hard_model,
          show.ci = FALSE, show.re.var = FALSE, show.icc = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE,
          dv.labels = "Story Comprehension Accuracy",
          pred.labels = c("Intercept (Original)",
                          "Pitch scrambled", "Rhythm jittered", "Pitch + Rhythm",
                          "Reverse music", "Silent"),
          title = "GLMER (Harder SNR): Accuracy by Background Condition")
tab_model(hard_model, file = "hard_model_results.doc")

# Post-hoc tests
emm <- emmeans(hard_model, ~ Condition)
pairs(emm, adjust = "bonferroni")


# Define orthogonal contrasts across 6 conditions
df$Condition <- factor(df$Condition,
                                levels = c("Original","Pitch scrambled","Rhythm jittered",
                                           "Pitch + Rhythm","Reverse music","Silent"))

orth1 <- c(-1/5, -1/5, -1/5, -1/5, -1/5, 1)   # Silent vs all sounds
orth2 <- c(1, -1/4, -1/4, -1/4, -1/4, 0)      # Original vs non-original sounds
orth3 <- c(0, -1/3, -1/3, -1/3, 1, 0)         # Reverse vs scrambled
orth4 <- c(0, -1, 1/2, 1/2, 0, 0)             # single vs double scrambled
orth5 <- c(0, 0, 1, -1, 0, 0)                 # rhythm vs pitch scrambled

contrast_matrix <- cbind(orth1, orth2, orth3, orth4, orth5)
contrasts(df$Condition) <- contrast_matrix
colnames(contrasts(df$Condition)) <- 
  c("Silent_vs_Sound","Original_vs_Sounds","Reverse_vs_Scrambled",
    "Single_vs_DoubleScrambled","Rhythm_vs_Pitch")

model_orth <- glmer(
  key_resp_4.corr ~ Condition + (Condition | participant) + (Condition | Story/text),
  data = df, family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2.5e5))
)

summary(model_orth)

tab_model(model_orth,
          show.ci = FALSE, show.re.var = FALSE, show.icc = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE,
          dv.labels = "Story Comprehension Accuracy",
          pred.labels = c("Intercept",
                          "Silent vs Sound","Original vs Sounds","Reverse vs Scrambled",
                          "Single vs Double Scrambled","Rhythm vs Pitch"),
          title = "GLMER with Orthogonal Contrasts")
tab_model(model_orth, file = "hard_model_orthogonal.doc")

```

```{r accuracy plots}
accuracy_stats <- df %>%
  group_by(participant, Condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(key_resp_4.corr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop")

group_sd_summary <- accuracy_stats %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(mean_acc), sd_acc = sd(mean_acc), .groups="drop")

colors <- c("Original"="tomato","Pitch scrambled"="turquoise",
            "Rhythm jittered"="pink","Pitch + Rhythm"="#8A2BE2",
            "Reverse music"="steelblue","Silent"="darkgreen")

accuracy_plot <- ggplot(accuracy_stats, aes(x=Condition, y=mean_acc, fill=Condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, width=0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width=0.15, alpha=0.2, size=1) +
  geom_point(data=group_sd_summary, aes(x=Condition, y=mean_acc),
             color="black", shape=18, size=3, inherit.aes=FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data=group_sd_summary,
                aes(x=Condition, ymin=mean_acc-sd_acc, ymax=mean_acc+sd_acc),
                width=0.2, color="black", inherit.aes=FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0.25,1)) +
  labs(x=NULL, y="Average Accuracy") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
        axis.title=element_text(size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(size=14),
        legend.position="none")

ggsave("accuracy_by_condition_harder.png", accuracy_plot, width=8, height=6, dpi=300)

```


```{r accuracy plot}
# Plot order (applied to a copy so the model contrasts are untouched)
cond_order <- c("Silent", "Original", "Reverse music",
                "Rhythm jittered", "Pitch scrambled", "Pitch + Rhythm")

plot_data <- df %>%
  group_by(participant, Condition) %>%
  summarise(acc = mean(key_resp_4.corr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(as.character(Condition), levels = cond_order))

set.seed(1)
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(x_jit = as.numeric(Condition) - 0.18 + runif(n(), -0.07, 0.07))
# Within-subject 95% CIs (Cousineau-Morey) 

grand_mean <- mean(plot_data$acc)
J <- n_distinct(plot_data$Condition)   # number of conditions (6)

ws_summary <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  mutate(acc_norm = acc - mean(acc) + grand_mean) %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(acc),
            n  = n(),
            se = sd(acc_norm) / sqrt(n) * sqrt(J / (J - 1)),
            ci = se * qt(.975, n - 1),
            .groups = "drop")

colors <- c("Silent" = "darkgreen", "Original" = "tomato",
            "Reverse music" = "steelblue", "Rhythm jittered" = "pink",
            "Pitch scrambled" = "turquoise", "Pitch + Rhythm" = "#8A2BE2")

accuracy_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Condition, y = acc)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = participant), color = "grey50",
            alpha = 0.12, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Condition), alpha = 0.25, size = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(data = ws_summary,
                aes(x = Condition, ymin = mean_acc - ci, ymax = mean_acc + ci),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = ws_summary,
             aes(x = Condition, y = mean_acc, fill = Condition),
             shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Silent" = "Silent",
                              "Original" = "Original music",
                              "Reverse music" = "Reversed",
                              "Rhythm jittered" = "Rhythm-jittered",
                              "Pitch scrambled" = "Pitch-scrambled",
                              "Pitch + Rhythm" = "Combined")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.25, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Comprehension accuracy") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.position = "none")

accuracy_plot
ggsave("accuracy_by_condition_harder.png", accuracy_plot,
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

#simpler plot
ws_summary_grouped <- ws_summary %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      Condition == "Silent"         ~ "No background",
      Condition == "Pitch + Rhythm" ~ "Little structure",
      TRUE                          ~ "Structure in ≥1 dimension"
    ),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("No background",
                                     "Structure in ≥1 dimension",
                                     "Little structure")),
    Condition = factor(Condition,
                       levels = c("Silent", "Original", "Reverse music",
                                  "Rhythm jittered", "Pitch scrambled",
                                  "Pitch + Rhythm"))
  )

orig_mean <- ws_summary$mean_acc[ws_summary$Condition == "Original"]

accuracy_plot_grouped <- ggplot(ws_summary_grouped,
                                aes(x = Condition, y = mean_acc, color = Condition)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = orig_mean, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_acc - ci, ymax = mean_acc + ci),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  facet_grid(~ group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Silent"          = "Silent",
                              "Original"        = "Original",
                              "Reverse music"   = "Reversed",
                              "Rhythm jittered" = "Rhythm-jittered",
                              "Pitch scrambled" = "Pitch-scrambled",
                              "Pitch + Rhythm"  = "Combined")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Story comprehension accuracy") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),

```{r bmrq integration}

# Load BMRQ file
harder_BMRQ <- read.csv("hardercondition_BMRQ_new.csv", header = TRUE)

# Scale BMRQ
harder_BMRQ$centered_BMRQ <- scale(harder_BMRQ$BMRQ, scale = TRUE)

# Keep relevant columns
harder_BMRQ_subset <- harder_BMRQ %>%
  select(participant, BMRQ, centered_BMRQ,
         jazz, familiarity, liking_this_music, liking_jazz, listening_jazz_freq,
         music, pitch, onset, reverse, pitch_onset)

# Merge into harder_data
df <- merge(df, harder_BMRQ_subset, by = "participant", all.x = TRUE)

# Reset reference level
df$Condition <- relevel(df$Condition, ref = "Original")

# GLMER with Condition × BMRQ
hard_model_bmrq <- glmer(
  key_resp_4.corr ~ Condition * centered_BMRQ + 
    (Condition | participant) + (Condition | Story/text),
  data = df, family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2.5e5))
)

summary(hard_model_bmrq)

# Export pretty table
tab_model(hard_model_bmrq,
          show.re.var = TRUE, show.icc = TRUE, show.r2 = TRUE,
          show.ci = FALSE, show.se = TRUE,
          dv.labels = "Accuracy (Hard Trials)",
          pred.labels = c(
            "(Intercept)",
            "Pitch + Rhythm","Pitch scrambled","Rhythm jittered",
            "Reverse music","Silent",
            "BMRQ (centered)",
            "Pitch + Rhythm × BMRQ","Pitch scrambled × BMRQ","Rhythm jittered × BMRQ",
            "Reverse music × BMRQ","Silent × BMRQ"
          ),
          title = "GLMER: Accuracy predicted by Condition × BMRQ")
tab_model(hard_model_bmrq, file="hard_model_bmrq.doc")

# Post-hoc contrasts
# This fixes BMRQ at its mean (0) explicitly, which should match your model output
emm_bmrq <- emmeans(hard_model_bmrq, ~ Condition, type="response", at = list(centered_BMRQ = 0))
pairs(emm_bmrq, adjust = "bonferroni")

```

```{r liking ratings by condition}

```{r sound ratings}
# Friedman test (non-parametric within-subjects)
friedman_data <- ratings %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  filter(all(!is.na(Rating))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(participant, Condition, .keep_all=TRUE)

friedman_test <- friedman.test(Rating ~ Condition | participant, data=friedman_data)
friedman_test

pairwise_results <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
  friedman_data$Rating, friedman_data$Condition,
  p.adjust.method="bonferroni", paired=TRUE
)
pairwise_results

# Wilcoxon tests vs Silent (Accuracy, harder SNR only)
pair_data <- df %>%
  filter(Condition %in% c("Silent","Original","Pitch scrambled","Rhythm jittered","Pitch + Rhythm","Reverse music")) %>%
  group_by(participant, Condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(key_resp_4.corr, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=Condition, values_from=mean_acc)

wilcox.test(pair_data$Silent, pair_data$`Original`, paired=TRUE)
wilcox.test(pair_data$Silent, pair_data$`Pitch scrambled`, paired=TRUE)
wilcox.test(pair_data$Silent, pair_data$`Rhythm jittered`, paired=TRUE)
wilcox.test(pair_data$Silent, pair_data$`Pitch + Rhythm`, paired=TRUE)
wilcox.test(pair_data$Silent, pair_data$`Reverse music`, paired=TRUE)

```

```{r anova on average accuracy}
## Average accuracy per participant × condition (harder SNR only)
anova_data <- df %>%
  group_by(participant, Condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(key_resp_4.corr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

anova_data <- anova_data %>% left_join(harder_BMRQ_subset, by = "participant")


anova_acc <- aov_ez(
  id = "participant",
  dv = "mean_acc",
  data = anova_data,
  within = "Condition",
  between_covariates = "centered_BMRQ",
  anova_table = list(
    correction = "GG",
    es = "pes"))

summary(anova_acc)
effectsize::eta_squared(anova_acc, partial = TRUE)

emm_cond <- emmeans(anova_acc, ~ Condition)
pairs(emm_cond, adjust = "bonferroni")
```

```{r kendall's rank correlations}
# Compute mean accuracy per participant per condition
kendall_data <- df %>%
  group_by(participant, Condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(key_resp_4.corr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(harder_BMRQ_subset %>% select(participant, BMRQ), by = "participant")

# Run Kendall correlation for each condition
kendall_results <- kendall_data %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    tau = cor.test(mean_acc, BMRQ, method = "kendall")$estimate,
    p_value = cor.test(mean_acc, BMRQ, method = "kendall")$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kendall_results

```{r masking check}
library(tidyverse)
library(afex)   # for aov_ez, handles repeated-measures ANOVA cleanly

masking <- read_csv("/Users/minemuezzinoglu/Documents/MATLAB/figures_new/EnergeticMaskingResults.csv")

# make sure Story and MaskerCondition are factors
masking <- masking %>%
  mutate(
    Story = factor(Story),
    MaskerCondition = factor(MaskerCondition)
  )

# repeated-measures ANOVA: MaskerCondition as within-story factor
masking_anova <- aov_ez(
  id = "Story",
  dv = "PercentMasked",
  within = "MaskerCondition",
  data = masking
)

masking_emm <- emmeans(masking_anova, ~ MaskerCondition)
pairs(masking_emm, adjust = "bonferroni")

```

```{r insert demographics}
library(readxl)
library(patchwork)

# ---- demographics ----
demo_raw <- read_excel("harder_data_pt3_demographics.xlsx")

demo <- demo_raw %>%
  rename(
    participant           = `Participant number (to be entered by Experimenter)`,
    age                    = Age,
    gender                 = `Gender (self-identified)`,
    music_training_years   = `How many years of formal training on a musical instrument (including voice) have you had in your lifetime?`,
    live_music_events      = `How many live music events have you attended in the past twelve months as an audience member?`,
    study_quiet_actual     = `How often do you study in these environments? - Quiet space`,
    study_coffee_actual    = `How often do you study in these environments? - Coffee shop or comparable`,
    study_music_actual     = `How often do you study in these environments? - With music in the background`,
    study_quiet_pref       = `How often would you prefer to study in these environments? - Quiet space`,
    study_coffee_pref      = `How often would you prefer to study in these environments? - Coffee shop or comparable`,
    study_music_pref       = `How often would you prefer to study in these environments? - With music in the background`
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(participant)) %>%                # drops 2 trailing summary rows
  mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
  filter(!participant %in% remove) %>%            # reuse your existing exclusion list
  mutate(study_music_diff = study_music_pref - study_music_actual) %>%
  select(participant, age, gender, music_training_years, live_music_events,
         study_quiet_actual, study_coffee_actual, study_music_actual,
         study_quiet_pref, study_coffee_pref, study_music_pref, study_music_diff)

# ---- accuracy: overall and by condition ----
acc_overall <- df %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  summarise(overall_acc = mean(key_resp_4.corr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

acc_by_cond <- df %>%
  group_by(participant, Condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(key_resp_4.corr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Condition, values_from = mean_acc, names_prefix = "acc_")

# ---- one row per participant: demographics + BMRQ + STOMP-R + jazz items + accuracy ----
corr_data <- harder_BMRQ %>%
  select(participant, BMRQ, Reflective_Complex, Intense_Rebellious, Upbeat_Conventional,
         Energetic_Rhythmic, Mellow, Unpretentious, Sophisticated, Intense, Contemporary,
         jazz, familiarity, liking_this_music, liking_jazz, listening_jazz_freq) %>%
  left_join(demo, by = "participant") %>%
  left_join(acc_overall, by = "participant") %>%
  left_join(acc_by_cond, by = "participant")

# ---- scatterplots: continuous demographic/questionnaire vars vs overall accuracy ----
scatter_vars <- c("age", "music_training_years", "live_music_events",
                   "study_quiet_actual", "study_coffee_actual", "study_music_actual",
                   "study_quiet_pref", "study_coffee_pref", "study_music_pref",
                   "study_music_diff", "BMRQ", "Reflective_Complex", "Intense_Rebellious",
                   "Upbeat_Conventional", "Energetic_Rhythmic", "Mellow", "Unpretentious",
                   "Sophisticated", "Intense", "Contemporary")

plot_list <- lapply(scatter_vars, function(v) {
  ggplot(corr_data, aes(x = .data[[v]], y = overall_acc)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "tomato") +
    labs(x = v, y = "Overall Accuracy") +
    theme_bw()
})
names(plot_list) <- scatter_vars

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 4)

# ---- jazz-liking vars vs accuracy, BY CONDITION ----
jazz_by_cond <- corr_data %>%
  select(participant, jazz, familiarity, liking_this_music, liking_jazz, listening_jazz_freq,
         starts_with("acc_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("acc_"), names_to = "condition", values_to = "acc", names_prefix = "acc_") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(jazz, familiarity, liking_this_music, liking_jazz, listening_jazz_freq),
               names_to = "jazz_measure", values_to = "rating")

ggplot(jazz_by_cond, aes(x = rating, y = acc)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "tomato") +
  facet_grid(jazz_measure ~ condition, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Rating", y = "Accuracy") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8))

# ---- study habits (actual + preferred) vs accuracy, BY CONDITION ----
study_by_cond <- corr_data %>%
  select(participant,
         quiet_actual = study_quiet_actual, quiet_pref = study_quiet_pref,
         coffee_actual = study_coffee_actual, coffee_pref = study_coffee_pref,
         music_actual = study_music_actual, music_pref = study_music_pref,
         starts_with("acc_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("acc_"), names_to = "condition", values_to = "acc", names_prefix = "acc_") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(quiet_actual, quiet_pref, coffee_actual, coffee_pref, music_actual, music_pref),
               names_to = "item", values_to = "rating") %>%
  separate(item, into = c("environment", "type"), sep = "_")

# full grid: every environment x actual/pref, every condition
ggplot(study_by_cond, aes(x = rating, y = acc)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "tomato") +
  facet_grid(environment + type ~ condition, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Rating (1-5)", y = "Accuracy") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7))

# ---- coffee shop specifically: does coffee-shop preference/habit relate to accuracy in a particular condition? ----
study_by_cond %>%
  filter(environment == "coffee") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rating, y = acc)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.3, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "tomato") +
  facet_grid(type ~ condition, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Coffee Shop Rating (1-5)", y = "Accuracy",
       title = "Coffee shop study habit/preference vs. accuracy by condition") +
  theme_bw()

library(tibble)
plot_corr_heatmap_rect <- function(data, predictor_vars, outcome_vars, title) {
  cor_mat <- cor(data[c(predictor_vars, outcome_vars)],
                  use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
  
  cor_sub <- cor_mat[predictor_vars, outcome_vars, drop = FALSE]
  
  cor_long <- as.data.frame(cor_sub) %>%
    rownames_to_column("predictor") %>%
    pivot_longer(-predictor, names_to = "condition", values_to = "r") %>%
    mutate(predictor = factor(predictor, levels = rev(predictor_vars)),
           condition = factor(condition, levels = outcome_vars))
  
  ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = condition, y = predictor, fill = r)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "white", high = "tomato",
                          midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Spearman\nr", title = title) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

acc_cond_vars <- paste0("acc_", cond_order)
acc_cond_vars <- acc_cond_vars[acc_cond_vars %in% names(corr_data)]

# study habits
plot_corr_heatmap_rect(corr_data,
  predictor_vars = c("study_quiet_actual", "study_coffee_actual", "study_music_actual",
                      "study_quiet_pref", "study_coffee_pref", "study_music_pref"),
  outcome_vars = acc_cond_vars,
  title = "Study Habits & Preferences vs. Accuracy")
ggsave("heatmap_study_habits_rect.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# STOMP-R
plot_corr_heatmap_rect(corr_data,
  predictor_vars = c("Reflective_Complex", "Intense_Rebellious", "Upbeat_Conventional",
                      "Energetic_Rhythmic", "Mellow", "Unpretentious", "Sophisticated",
                      "Intense", "Contemporary"),
  outcome_vars = acc_cond_vars,
  title = "STOMP-R Subscales vs. Accuracy")
ggsave("heatmap_stompr_rect.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# music preferences / experience
plot_corr_heatmap_rect(corr_data,
  predictor_vars = c("music_training_years", "live_music_events", "familiarity",
                      "liking_this_music", "liking_jazz", "listening_jazz_freq", "BMRQ"),
  outcome_vars = acc_cond_vars,
  title = "Music Preferences & Experience vs. Accuracy")
ggsave("heatmap_music_preferences_rect.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
